label: Code + rendered output
description: A terminal/editor window (the window is the primary self-framed object) with traffic-light dots, a filename bar and 2-10 mono code lines, paired with a second darker output panel that shows the rendered result with its own label bar and 1-6 output lines. Optional eyebrow + title above. The window pops first and its lines x-stagger; the output panel reveals AFTER the code (beat ~+1.2s). Desktop places the window wide on the left and the output panel on the right; portrait stacks the window over the output.
